import pandas as pd

data = {'job_code': ['AAAHN_1', 'ZZUGD_2', 'ZZUGD_3'],
        'file_type': ['original', 'review', 'review'],
        'count': [1, 1, 1]}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

count_df = df.groupby(['job_code', 'file_type']).size().unstack().fillna(0)

same_count = count_df[count_df['original'] == count_df['review']].index.tolist()

print(len(same_count))
